narrative.overview: A graphite screening annex, not a house or a film studio identity. Extended pale-yellow lettering sits outside the projected artwork. Reading changes material to an illuminated concrete inscription spread, without a floating content card.
keyCharacteristics: Three architectural bays per floor; four independently navigable floors.
Original still imagery, grain, restrained projection light and floor reflection.
Unboxed reading, clear return path, realistic personal facts.
dos: Do keep substantial text out of canvas and projections.
Do keep four named floors reachable without gestures.
Do preserve the horizontal multi-bay room and vertical navigation ritual.
donts: Don't borrow reference logos, copyrighted films, models or agency claims.
Don't turn reading into floating rounded cards.
